Shift Report for 2026-08-06 00:00 to 00:05:

During the reporting period, a person on foot was observed approaching the main gate of the Chakan Industrial Plant from the access road at 00:01:05. The individual proceeded to walk along the fence at the main gate, returned to the gate, and stood motionless at 00:02:50. At 00:03:25, the person was seen reaching towards the gate latch. They then crouched near the main gate post at 00:04:00 and looked back over their shoulder repeatedly at 00:04:35. The person walked away from the main gate along the fence line at 00:05:10. No security breaches or detections were recorded during this period.
